rules.routed_bonds: Semantic bonds may route through legal lattice segments. An inactive seme crossed by a route remains unmarked and contributes no meaning.
rules.activation: Only explicitly active seme nodes contribute meaning.
rules.query: QUERY is structural, not a seme.
rules.index: INDEX is structural, not a seme.
rules.order_polarity: ORDER may carry + or - orientation along an understood dimension.
rules.measure: Quantitative payloads attach without creating new semes.
rules.polysemy: Polysemous English words split by sense.
rules.normalization: English grammatical distinctions may collapse when they are not semantic distinctions.
